# sks3200_ip_address_settings (Resource)

IPv4 management address. Destroying it leaves the switch as is. Changing the address moves the switch away from the provider's url; update url to match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sks3200_ip_address_settings" "this" {
  ip_address = "192.168.10.12"
  netmask    = "255.255.255.0"
  gateway    = "192.168.10.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Get the address by DHCP; ip_address, netmask and gateway are then not sent to the switch. Defaults to false.
- `gateway` (String) Default gateway. Keeps the switch's current value if unset.
- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 address, e.g. 192.168.10.12. Keeps the switch's current value if unset.
- `netmask` (String) Dotted-quad netmask, e.g. 255.255.255.0. Keeps the switch's current value if unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "network".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sks3200_ip_address_settings.this network
```
